items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I've told a couple of people, like Susannah...you know Susannah Claude(?). I told her to walk up to Sarah and say "kaiseki"(?).

ctx.x: And the word is "kaiseki"(?). I've told a couple of people, like Susannah...you know Susannah Claude(?). I told her to walk up to Sarah and say "kaiseki"(?). And Sarah turned around and she said, "You've been talking to Jimmy."

But I adore her. I adore her. Personally. Everything. Every wise, every way. I think she is just... And her sense of humor is ridiculous, it's so much. She came to my house one night, and she saw these two little kittens playing, and she'd never seen this. Marshall was with her. And she said, "Marshall, I want two cats." She said, "What will I start with? I want two of the best." I said, "You might as well start at the top. Get a couple of Abyssinians." So next night, the phone rang. They paid seventy-five bucks…
